title: Scene Transition Flow
description: How VR scene loading works: AdaSceneManager → VRStaging → GridSystem. Critical timing: wait 3 frames after instantiation.
earned_from: DeepWiki: VR Staging Scene Loading Choreography

nodes.label: Pass user_data to scene
nodes.detail: Try scene.set_scene_user_data(data), fallback to set_meta('scene_user_data', data)

nodes.label: Wait 3 process frames
nodes.detail: CRITICAL: await get_tree().process_frame x3. All _ready() must complete before grid operations.

nodes.label: GridSystem.load_map(map_name)
nodes.detail: Reads map_data.json, instantiates structure + utilities + artifacts

summary: load_scene → fade → instantiate → pass user_data → WAIT 3 FRAMES → GridSystem.load_map → scene_visible. The 3-frame wait is critical.
